raw_response:
Structural program complete.
Brutally: under the constraints you give, I do not see a genuinely new, non-vacuous, label-free structural bridge direction still worth deriving inside the Window6↔codon-Q6 program.
The reason is not “we ran out of imagination.” It is structural.
The carrier is now too tightly closed: a partition of  $Q_6$  into genetic-code fibers, with degeneracy, box/wobble composition, edge margins, boundary degrees, component structure, square-face motifs, quotient topology, bypass conductance, and non-q6 embeddings all audited. The only invariant that remains non-null is  $e_{\rm in}$ , the count of hidden one-step synonymous edges. Once  $e_{\rm in}$  is conditioned out, the residual label-free invariant space has repeatedly behaved as typical. That means any further structural statistic would almost certainly fall into one of three bad classes:


A disguised  $e_{\rm in}$  functional.
It would count a higher-order object but derive its signal from how many synonymous edges are present.


A composition/fold artifact.
It would repackage box, wobble, degeneracy, GC-position, branch split, or quotient-equitability information already shown to lie in the control span.


A post-hoc separator.
Since any finite partition can be separated by some artificial invariant, one can always manufacture a label-free-looking functional that picks out the standard code. But without an independent canonical reason for that functional before seeing the code, it is numerology.


A “complete invariant” of the partition under cube automorphisms would of course distinguish or classify the code, but that is vacuous: it would be a fingerprint, not a forcing bridge. Likewise, moving to RNA secondary structures, tRNA cloverleafs, or arc diagrams could become a real new program, but it would not be a remaining direction of this bridge unless there is an independently forced mathematical object and a non-circular map to a hard enumerable biological carrier. Otherwise it restarts the same count-matching trap under new vocabulary.
So the honest conclusion is:
The structural bridge has reached its natural culmination.
It has one real structural positive: contravariant edge-hiding extremality. It has one strong closure result: all other canonical label-free codon-graph structure is typical once the correct nulls are imposed. It has one failed direction: non-q6 Window6-to-codon forcing. That is a clean outcome, not a disappointment.
The remaining frontier is empirical/bio, not more structural invariant mining.
The most important open question is:
Does the certified  $e_{\rm in}$  extremality actually buy measurable biological robustness, or is it only a combinatorial optimum?
More sharply:
Across degeneracy-matched genetic codes, does higher synonymous edge hiding predict lower experimentally measured mistranslation damage, and is the standard code’s robustness exhausted once  $e_{\rm in}$  is conditioned on?
That is the decisive question because either answer is informative. If yes, the bridge has found a real biological consequence for its lone structural positive. If no, then the correct final statement is even cleaner: Window6↔codon produced a mathematically certified tolerance contrast, but not a demonstrated biological forcing mechanism.
